1.title: Investors face personal financial pressure
1.description: Investors stop or pause their SIPs when facing unexpected expenses, job losses, or competing debt obligations.
1.rationale: Groww cannot solve an investor's personal cash crunch, but flexible pause and modification controls can reduce complete SIP cancellations.

8.title: Unexplained debit and cancellation charges
8.description: Investors cancel SIPs or abandon the platform after experiencing unexpected debit deductions, bounce fees, or delayed support.
8.rationale: Groww can directly improve support turnaround, clarify debit timings, and provide transparent status updates for cancelled or pending orders.

11.title: Autopay execution and duplicate debits
11.description: Investors stop SIPs when autopay fails to debit on time, deducts duplicate amounts, or remains stuck during cancellation.
11.rationale: Groww can directly improve mandate reliability, fix status syncing, and clarify bank autopay cancellation processes.

2.title: Underperforming SIP returns prompt exit
2.description: Investors stop SIPs and redeem funds after observing flat or negative investment returns over time.
2.rationale: Groww cannot influence market returns, but better contextual information on long-term investing concepts can help investors make informed choices.

3.title: Confusion around SIP management rules
3.description: Investors cancel their SIPs due to lack of clarity on how to pause, stop, or withdraw funds.
3.rationale: Groww can directly provide clear self-serve product guidance and intuitive in-app controls for pausing, stopping, and redeeming SIPs.

7.title: Stopping SIPs to consolidate portfolio
7.description: Investors stop existing SIPs to clear portfolio clutter or switch to direct plans but delay restarting.
7.rationale: Groww can build seamless portfolio consolidation and fund-switching tools that allow investors to streamline investments without manual stops.

17.title: Switching SIPs to competing platforms
17.description: Investors stop their active SIPs and migrate to other platforms seeking better portfolio tracking or features.
17.rationale: Groww can improve dashboard tracking, return analytics, and external folio consolidation, though user platform preference is partially external.

5.title: Reallocating funds to other assets
5.description: Investors stop mutual fund SIPs to reallocate their capital into direct stocks, fixed deposits, or alternative assets.
5.rationale: Groww cannot dictate investor asset allocation choices, but can offer better portfolio visibility across asset classes within the app.

9.title: Insufficient bank balance on debit
9.description: Investors face missed SIP installments and bank bounce charges when account balances are low on the debit date.
9.rationale: Groww can send timely balance reminder alerts, allow easy date changes, and provide skip-installment options to prevent bounce charges.

13.title: Fund house stops accepting SIPs
13.description: Investors experience automated SIP cancellations because the underlying AMC halts fresh inflows into the scheme.
13.rationale: AMC decisions to cap or restrict inflows into mutual fund schemes are entirely outside of Groww's operational control.

6.title: External advice triggers SIP cancellation
6.description: Investors cancel SIPs after receiving external advice from agents, friends, or third-party advisors to switch funds.
6.rationale: Third-party financial advice given to investors outside the app is beyond Groww's direct control or influence.

10.title: Bank account update fails autopay
10.description: Investors stop SIPs when changing their primary bank account fails to update the linked autopay mandate.
10.rationale: Groww can simplify the bank account modification workflow and enable fast, digital mandate updates for active SIPs.

12.title: KYC issues block SIP orders
12.description: Investors experience SIP cancellations or rejected transactions due to invalid PAN statuses or incomplete KYC requirements.
12.rationale: While regulatory KYC criteria are set externally, Groww can streamline verification tracking and proactively notify investors of status changes.

4.title: Changing financial goals and regimes
4.description: Investors stop SIPs when their tax-saving requirements or overall monthly allocation targets change over time.
4.rationale: Changes in tax regulations and individual goal requirements are personal investor decisions outside Groww's control.

14.title: Paused SIPs remain inactive long-term
14.description: Investors pause their SIPs for a temporary period but fail to resume them afterwards.
14.rationale: Groww can implement automated resume schedules and clear status notifications to help investors resume paused SIPs effortlessly.

16.title: Market drawdown fears pause investing
16.description: Investors pause their SIPs due to market volatility concerns or overall market pullback expectations.
16.rationale: Groww cannot control investor sentiment or market drawdowns, but can provide clear, non-coercive educational material on market cycles.

15.title: Hassle in restarting cancelled SIPs
15.description: Investors cancel their existing regular SIPs and find the manual setup process to restart cumbersome.
15.rationale: Groww can offer a one-click SIP re-activation or quick setup workflow to reduce friction when starting fresh SIPs.
